records.name: USA₮
records.identity_decision: USA₮ is a separate U.S.-regulated stablecoin and must not be merged with Tether USD₮. Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. is the legal issuer; Tether product, brand, technology, and distribution support must remain separate from issuance.
records.backing_decision: Official launch material describes a federally regulated dollar-backed stablecoin. Exact reserve composition, eligible instruments, custody, segregation, and recurring attestation scope require terms-level normalization.
records.redemption_decision: Institutional issuance and redemption are expected through regulated onboarding routes. Direct holder eligibility, minimums, fees, settlement timing, and secondary-market-holder rights require primary program terms.
records.income_decision: No intrinsic holder yield is established for base USA₮. Reserve income, platform rewards, and distribution incentives must remain separate from token-holder accrual.
records.deployment_decision: Official material confirms the product launch and later Ethereum support. Exact first mint, canonical contract, authority controls, and any additional networks require direct verification.
blocking_unknowns: complete Anchorage issuance and redemption terms
reserve composition, custody, and segregation map
canonical contract, mint authority, and freeze authority
complete recurring attestation archive
current institutional and retail distribution eligibility

records.name: EURAU
records.identity_decision: EURAU is the euro-denominated stablecoin issued by AllUnity. DWS, Flow Traders, Galaxy, reserve banks, custodians, market makers, and distribution partners must not be represented as co-issuers unless primary legal material establishes that role.
records.backing_decision: AllUnity describes EURAU as fully reserved and MiCAR-compliant. The exact reserve allocation, safeguarding accounts, bank diversification, eligible instruments, and attestation chronology require primary report normalization.
records.redemption_decision: Initial issuance and redemption were directed toward onboarded institutional customers and partners. Current end-user access, redemption eligibility, minimums, fees, timing, and agent routes require current terms review.
records.income_decision: No intrinsic holder yield is established for base EURAU. Reserve earnings, liquidity-provider incentives, and partner rewards must remain separate.
records.deployment_decision: Ethereum is the original launch deployment. Later Base and other network expansions must be modeled as subsequent deployments with separate contract and bridge verification.
blocking_unknowns: complete reserve-allocation and safeguarding chronology
current direct issuance and redemption eligibility
canonical contracts and authority controls across networks
complete attestation and audit archive
current reserve-bank, custodian, and liquidity-provider role map

records.name: Noble Dollar
records.identity_decision: Noble Dollar is a separate USDN identity and must not be merged with the existing Neutrino USD record. It is a Noble-issued extension built with M0 infrastructure, with Noble, M0, collateral validators, bridge providers, and integrators modeled as distinct roles.
records.backing_decision: Official material describes full backing through short-term U.S. Treasury-bill exposure inherited from the M0 base asset. The exact collateral portfolio, validator reports, custody, and reserve-liability chain require normalization.
records.redemption_decision: USDN conversion and liquidity routes operate through Noble, M0, and supported integrations. Primary mint and redemption eligibility, direct settlement assets, fees, delays, and emergency controls require contract and terms review.
records.income_decision: Base USDN is designed to pass through variable yield without staking or lockups. Boosted-yield vaults, points programs, and integrator incentives are separate layers and must not be merged into the base income profile.
records.deployment_decision: USDN launched on Noble and uses M0 Portal and Wormhole NTT-based infrastructure for cross-ecosystem movement. Native, bridged, and integrated representations require separate canonicality review.
blocking_unknowns: legal issuer, extension operator, and redemption-agent role map
complete M0 collateral and validator-report linkage
primary mint and redemption terms
canonical deployment and bridge representation inventory
base yield versus vault, points, and integrator reward boundaries

records.name: USDH
records.identity_decision: USDH is the Hyperliquid-native stablecoin designed by Native Markets and issued through Bridge infrastructure. The base token, HyperCore representation, linked HyperEVM ERC-20, reserve managers, issuer, and ecosystem contributors require distinct role and deployment treatment.
records.backing_decision: Official material describes 1:1 backing with cash, U.S. Treasury exposure, and cash equivalents. Off-chain and on-chain reserve management, custody, monthly attestations, and the allocation of reserve income require time-bounded normalization.
records.redemption_decision: Official documentation describes 1:1 bank-dollar and USDC mint and redemption routes for approved institutional users. Current availability during the migration period, eligibility, minimums, fees, timing, and final redemption deadlines require review.
records.income_decision: Base USDH does not document intrinsic holder yield. Reserve income is allocated to ecosystem contributions and growth programs rather than automatically accruing to every holder.
records.deployment_decision: USDH spans a HyperCore native token and a linked HyperEVM ERC-20 representation. Exact launch dates, contracts, linking controls, treasury-deployer transition, and post-migration canonical status require direct verification.
blocking_unknowns: canonical public launch date and first mint
Bridge issuer terms and direct redemption agreement
HyperCore and HyperEVM contract and authority map
migration timeline, final support date, and successor-liquidity boundary
complete reserve attestation and income-allocation chronology

records.name: AE Coin
records.identity_decision: AE Coin is the AED-referenced payment token issued by AED Stablecoin LLC. The issuer conducts B2B minting, while appointed agents handle custody, transfer, conversion, and end-customer relationships; those roles must remain separate.
records.backing_decision: Official material states that one AEC targets one AED and that the product operates under CBUAE regulation. Exact reserve composition, safeguarding, bank accounts, segregation, attestations, and holder-claim structure require primary legal and financial documentation.
records.redemption_decision: AED Stablecoin LLC does not maintain direct end-customer relationships. Redemption and conversion are performed through authorized agents, so agent eligibility, fees, limits, timing, and issuer-level settlement rights require normalization.
records.income_decision: No intrinsic holder yield is established for base AEC. Agent rewards, account benefits, and reserve earnings must remain separate.
records.deployment_decision: Official material confirms blockchain issuance but does not yet provide a sufficiently normalized canonical chain, contract, mint authority, freeze authority, or version history for promotion.
blocking_unknowns: canonical launch date and first public circulation boundary
complete reserve, safeguarding, and attestation structure
authorized agent inventory and role chronology
direct and indirect redemption terms for institutions and end users
canonical chain, contract, and administrative-control map
